---
description: The lines shown in the chat's thinking block while a turn is being worked on. One kind of line per row, a name, a colon, then its text. Change the words freely. Delete a row and that kind of line is no longer shown, except the row named still, which keeps a long turn alive in Lumiverse. The rows named tool, delegate, question and thinking name an agent as a person calls it; `is.<kind>` says whose it is (author, gm, narrator, character, other), `name` is the character's name, or the agent's definition for another, and `nth` is set where the turn has another agent of that kind before it. The row named tool is shown as a tool begins; `doing` says what the tool does in a few words, from the `doing` line of its file in `.tools/`, and `tool` is its own name, for a tool whose file gives none. The row named rule is shown as a rule fires; `title` is what the rule is called, from the `title` line of its file (none where its file gives none), `rule` is its file's name, and `shipped` is set for a rule that ships with RPE, which nobody here wrote or changed. The row named retrying is shown when a call to a model failed and is made again; `is.<kind>` says what broke it (connection, timeout, overloaded, server, other), `wait` is the wait before the next try in words (none where it is made at once), `next` that try's number and `most` the most tries there will be. The row named thinking heads each stretch of an agent's thinking, which goes into the thinking block as it is written where the setting Thinking in the chat lets it.
format: lines
---
intake: Reading the chat for the briefing.

waiting_previous: Finishing the last turn's work first.

agents: {{count}} agents at work.
